IC1: Surgery [OR] and/or previous ocular pathology (presence of scar [OR]/change in the cornea [OR], glaucoma [OR], retinopathies, etc.).
IC2: Patient has diabetes [OR] or is immunodepressed.
IC3: Any systemic infection during the study.
IC4: Signs and/or symptoms of ocular inflammation [OR]/infection (bacterial [OR], viral [OR], fungal [OR], caused [OR] by [OR] Chlamydia [OR], by Mycobacterium, Acanthamoeba or of allergic etiology).
IC5: Have used any systemic [OR] or topical antibiotics [AND] for ocular infection in the previous 14 days.
IC6: Patient has known hypersensitivity to any of the components of the formulations used in the study.
